label: Instant asset write-off limit (aggregated turnover under $10 million)
quote: the full cost of eligible depreciating assets costing less than $20,000 that are first used or installed ready for use in an income year
period_quote: Under the measure, from 1 July 2026, small businesses with an aggregated turnover of less than $10 million, can deduct:
pattern: eligible depreciating assets costing less than (\$[\d,]+) that are first used
notes: Permanent from 1 July 2026: the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 2) Act 2026 (No. 71, 2026) Sch 2 item 3 replaced $1,000 with $20,000 in ITAA 1997 s 328-180(1)(b) for assets first used, or installed ready for use, for a taxable purpose on or after 1 July 2026 (item 15(1)): https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2026A00071/asmade. The page says 'This measure is now law.' The same limit applies to the first later amount included in the second element of an asset's cost (items 4, 5 and 15(2)); other conditions and exclusions apply.
